status: frozen before execution (plan approved by the user 2026-10-02: 'follow the sensible plan, keep iterating'; frozen before any fresh-panel-2 result was read)
research_goal: Robot intuitive physics engine: judge fragility at the agent's own uncertainty scale from REAL camera perception, then read outcomes from visual tokens instead of object state.
panel: fresh panel 2 (reset seed episode_id + 6000), the identical selected states of results/jenga/fresh_fragility_v2_protocol.json, reached by the identical chain replay. Panel 2's synthetic-noise results are not used for any choice here.

perception.model: results/program_b/perception/dinov2_close_keypoint.pt: frozen DINOv2 tokens of one close-fixed-camera frame (addendum 1 camera) -> keypoint head (addendum 2 recipe), trained on V1 TRAIN layouts only
perception.error_model: results/jenga/visual_perception_error_model.json: full 9x9 covariance of held-out block-position errors and a per-block 3x3 covariance of rotation-vector errors (validation residuals, no task label). Zero-mean sampling; the measured bias is reported, not subtracted.
perception.perceived_scene: s_hat_vis: the true chunk-start state with the three blocks' poses replaced by the perception model's estimate from the rendered frame; velocities and gripper kept (a single frame cannot see velocity; the gripper is proprioception)

step1_monitors.aware_v1_vis: probe j from s_hat_vis + e_j, e_j ~ the measured error model
step1_monitors.aware_v2_vis: 5 hypotheses h_m = s_hat_vis + d_m (d_m ~ error model); aware sampling around each; alarm if >= 3/5 fragile
step1_monitors.rule: monitor v1 persistent split on non-robot positions at hold 10 and 30, unchanged

step1_ground_truth.fragility_vis: v1 split on aware sampling centred on the TRUE state with the SAME measured error model, two independent seeds A and B (the agent's own uncertainty scale is now the measured one, not 2.65 mm isotropic)
step1_ground_truth.harm_fork: 2-62 of the 64 truth-A rollouts topple a neighbour (tilt >= 45 deg among blocks starting below 45)

step1_gates.G1_calibration: aware_v2_vis kappa with truth A >= 0.8 x truth A-vs-B kappa, recall of fragile >= 0.80, alarms on robust <= truth B's alarm-on-robust + 0.10

step2_token_outcomes.rendering: cam_fixed (default) frames at hold steps 10 and 30 of every exact-state probe and every aware_v1_vis rollout, 240 x 320
step2_token_outcomes.tokens: the bundled frozen DINOv2 encoder at 196 x 196 (14 x 14 patches x 384), full frame, flattened; no object mask, no state
step2_token_outcomes.rule: the SAME persistent_mode_alarm on the flattened token endings at hold 10 and 30
step2_token_outcomes.gate_T: token decisions agree with the state-position decisions on the same rollouts with kappa >= 0.70, separately for the exact-state probes and for the aware_v1_vis rollouts

reporting: all monitors (naive, aware v1, aware v2; synthetic results from panel 2 shown beside for context) with Wilson intervals; per-block perception error on the panel states (true vs estimated); token-vs-state confusion tables
decision: Step 1 confirmed if G1, G2 and G3 pass; Step 2 confirmed if gate_T passes for both rollout sets. Each is reported separately; no re-selection.
scope: Track A physics (exact simulator); perception and outcome reading are real visual pipelines. Generalization note: the perception head was trained on V1 TRAIN layouts and is applied to new (seed + 6000) layouts.
cost: about 160 states x (naive 64 + aware v1 64 + aware v2 320 + truth 128) rollouts with the chain replayed, plus about 41k rendered frames: about 4 h CPU, then minutes of GPU encoding
